from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    template = None
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            if any(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
                template = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1)] for r in range(r0, r1)]
                break
        if template is not None:
            break
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = template[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
